Product Manager with 8.5+ years of experience building and scaling B2B and B2C SaaS products across 
construction, healthcare, telecom, banking, and eCommerce. Proven in defining product vision, executing

and double -digit adoption growth. Strong in customer discovery, stakeholder alignment, and Agile 
delivery, with experience driving cloud-based product evolution and leveraging Generative AI to improve 
productivity and business impact.

Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs.

document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.

ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery.

enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve 
product intelligence. 
• Led hands-on development and productization of OpenAI-powered GenAI features, working closely with 
engineering teams on prompt design, retrieval workflows, evaluation, and production deployment. 
 
• Product Execution: End-to-end product lifecycle ownership, feature prioritization, Prioritization 
Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), OKRs, Roadmap execution, UAT, release management, and post-
launch performance tracking. 
 
• Data & Metrics: Definition and tracking of product KPIs, user engagement and retention metrics, 
funnel analysis, ROI and cost-benefit analysis, and executive reporting. 
 
• Technical & Platforms: Working knowledge of API Design and Integrations, Data Modeling, Python, 
Cloud Platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Power BI), Cloud SQL, SaaS 
architectures, Microservices, CI/CD exposure, Schema Designs and GenAI-enabled product features. 
 
• Tools & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Figma, Aha! , Git, Smartsheet, Swagger,

term client partnerships, positioning organizations as trusted partners over vendors. 
 
• Domains: Banking, Healthcare, Telecom, eCommerce, Construction, Travel, Education, and Cloud-
based enterprise platforms.

Project Name: SP Portal 
Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 | 
Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git. 
 
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations, 
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who 
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by 
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application 
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple 
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate 
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow. 
Responsibilities 
• Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into 
BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

workshops for requirement clarification.

quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.

business outcomes. 
• Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and 
process optimization.

seamless product releases.

needs.

better system performance. 
Project Name: Cadent 
Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021

Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas

users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on 
location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for 
processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes 
connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.

acceptance criteria for development.
